title: The job that doesn't exist anymore 🤯
description:
Before alarm clocks, who woke up the working class? See how the London knocker upper started his day in 1900.

This video recreates the morning routine of a historic profession that relied on long poles and timing to signal factory workers. If you enjoy historical reenactments or learning about lost jobs from the industrial era, this look back is for you.

Subscribe for more glimpses into forgotten history.
